**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Normalize legacy productions before comparing snapshots**

For an existing production stored without `updatedAt` or with an older format stamp, installation always reports a conflict even when nothing changed. `loadShows()` applies `readShape()` in `src/model/shows.ts`, so `plan.before` contains the normalized version and backfilled timestamp, but this comparison reads the unnormalized database record. I reproduced an unchanged production being refused solely because its stored timestamp was absent; retries produce the same refusal. Apply the same read normalization inside the transaction before comparing snapshots, while retaining the comparison against genuine concurrent edits.

AGENTS.md reference: [src/AGENTS.md:L13-L13](https://github.com/NoaCG/NoaCG-Studio/blob/63d7d7b57253f49cdcfcaa20a5805dbdcc8c2baf/src/AGENTS.md#L13-L13)
